title: Digital Farming Fence
description: March 2025 commission through Zac Suvalko at Studio 024 for an undisclosed end client. Studio 024 supplied the isometric illustration; EWSPLAT developed the hybrid 2D/3D Blender animation, including the cows, paddock movement, virtual fence and grazing effects, satellite and signal elements, information graphics and feedback refinements.
